1.11.0

Exercise navigation rework (Chris's prototype 2). The wrapping row of date chips is gone: under the day heading sits a Monday→Sunday week strip — weekday letter, dot, day number per cell; solid dot = a workout logged that day, open ring = nothing; selected day in the label colour with a 2px ink outline, today's number underlined bold, Mondays shaded like the sheet's boxed Mondays, days after today dimmed and inert (you can't log a future workout — a staged next-month sheet is read-only), out-of-month days blank. `‹ ›` page a week at a time and stop at the viewed month's first/last week; changing months stays with the sheet's month selector. Tapping the day heading (now with a `▾`, the same tap-the-label idiom as the month name) or the quiet `▾ SHOW MONTH` handle unfolds the strip in place into every Monday-start week of the month under an M–S header (gutters blank, no arrows, no overlay — the sheet stays mounted); picking a day there selects it and folds back to its week. The sheet no longer pads to six empty rows: it shows only rows with content plus one blank, `+ EXERCISE` appends another blank, and `+ SET` still reveals sets 4–5. Empty weight/rep/time/dist inputs ghost the previous session of that exercise (newest row dated before the selected day) as italic ~35% placeholders — never values, so an untouched ghost saves nothing; an exercise's first-ever session simply has no ghost. Server: the month payload gains `exercise_prior` — the newest pre-month row per active exercise from one grouped query — which the client merges with the month's own rows, so picking a day needs no round trip; the demo mock mirrors it and seeds ten August workout days. Week math and the "newest candidate" pick live in a new pure `lib/workout.js`, unit-tested under node from `tests.php` alongside new PHP checks for `exercise_prior`.

1.11.2

The hidden month-picker input is now hidden by an inline style as well as the stylesheet, so a browser holding a stale `styles.css` alongside fresh JavaScript can't render it as a visible "2026-08" box beside the month name (seen once on the beta channel). No behavior change.
